record.question: Who invented color photography?
record.explanation: The object-holding museum records Maxwell's 1855 three-colour proposal and 1861 demonstration using photographs commissioned from Thomas Sutton. Maxwell is uniquely relevant among choices. Credit the method/demonstration and Sutton's photography rather than sole creation of all colour processes. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.nms.ac.uk/discover-catalogue/edinburgh-physicist-james-clerk-maxwells-explorations-in-colour Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
